defects.what: Step 4 asks for a test of reasonWords's three cases (no_list with a format → noListIn, low_fit with no best → noFit, no format → noFit) if a test file for the view or a nearby view helper exists. web/src/lib/mtgoPicks.test.ts already tests this view's helpers (resultWords, matchesWord) with `translator('en')`, so the condition holds. reasonWords was not exported and no MtgoPicksView.test.ts was added, so the new TS branch is not pinned (revert_ts is null). There is no report saying the test was skipped on purpose. Fix: export reasonWords and add a pure-function test of about 15 lines.

structured_output.summary: The API side is correct and small. MtgoUnsurePick gets `format: str | None` with a Field description in its neighbours' style. The route fills it from `info[match_id]["inferred"]`, which is the same value it passes into PickMatch.format, so mtgo/picks.py is untouched. Types were regenerated (api.ts only; this repo has no web/openapi.json). Both locale strings are exactly as the brief gives them. reasonWords uses formatName only for `no_list` and falls back to noFit for low_fit without a best list and for a match with no format. The stale comment was replaced with a true one. No doc sentence names the unsure item's fields or the old line, so leaving docs alone is right. The new test_api test inserts a Modern inference for match A and none for B, and its expected values come from that data. It fails when the change is reverted. ruff, the brief's pytest set (417 passed, re-run here), web lint, web tests and tsc all pass. The one full-suite failure is test_backlog's "ROADMAP.md:68: dangling BL-052", caused by the commit-time BACKLOG bookkeeping, which is not part of the change and not charged to it. The CHANGELOG line is the same bookkeeping. One defect: the conditional TS test of reasonWords's three cases is missing, even though a nearby view-helper test file (lib/mtgoPicks.test.ts) exists, so the frontend branch is unpinned.
